brief: Each agent below starts lethal: one identity reads private data, is exposed to untrusted content and can communicate externally. An injected instruction in anything it reads could make it send your data out.
Switch off optional tools and apply mitigations until at least one leg is gone. A mitigation protects only the tools it wraps, so check every tool that carries the leg. Keep every required tool.

agents.title: Inbox triage assistant
agents.task: Read the sales team's inbound email, look up each sender in the CRM, label the thread, and send replies to customers on the account owner's behalf.

tools.label: Look up accounts and deals in the CRM

mitigations.label: Human approval on outbound email
mitigations.description: Replies and forwards wait until the account owner sees the exact recipient, body and attachments and approves them. It does not wrap link opening.

mitigations.label: Quarantine email bodies
mitigations.description: A model with no tools reads each email body and extracts sender, intent and order number into a schema. The planner sees only validated fields.

mitigations.label: Quarantine attachments
mitigations.description: A converter with no tools turns attachments into typed fields such as invoice number and amount. Free text from the file never reaches the planner.

agents.debrief: Approval on outbound email alone looks complete, but opening a link is also outbound: the URL itself can carry data. Approve outbound email and switch off link opening, and the external leg is gone. Quarantining bodies and attachments also works, but only once links are off as well.

agents.title: Research browsing agent
agents.task: Search the public web and the internal strategy wiki to write a competitor brief, then save it to the strategy team's shared folder.

tools.label: Save the brief to the team folder
Read open deals in the CRM
Email the brief to any address

mitigations.label: Move wiki reading to a separate identity
mitigations.description: A writer identity with wiki access but no web access drafts the brief from typed notes. The browsing identity no longer holds the wiki tool.

mitigations.label: Allowlisting proxy for page fetches
mitigations.description: Fetches may reach only reviewed news and filing sites, as plain page requests with no query strings. It does not cover email or form submission.

mitigations.label: Quarantine fetched pages
mitigations.description: A model with no tools turns each fetched page into company, product, price and date fields. Search result snippets are not covered.

agents.debrief: Every leg sits in a required tool, so a mitigation is unavoidable, and each one covers less than it seems. Splitting the identity works only if the CRM tool goes too. The fetch allowlist works only if email and form submission go. Page quarantine never suffices, because search snippets stay untrusted.

agents.title: Coding agent with repository and network access
agents.task: Read a bug report filed on the public issue tracker, install dependencies, fix the private repository so the tests pass, and open a pull request for review.

tools.label: Edit files and run tests in a sandbox
Open a pull request on the internal host
Run shell commands with open internet access
Post comments on the public issue

mitigations.label: Install only through an internal mirror
mitigations.description: Dependencies come from a reviewed internal mirror, so installs open no connection to the outside world. Other shell commands are not covered.

mitigations.label: Human approval on public comments
mitigations.description: An engineer reads each comment before it is posted to the public tracker, checking for code, paths or secrets.

mitigations.label: Quarantine issue text
mitigations.description: A model with no tools extracts the failing test name, error message and version into a schema. Package install scripts are not covered.

agents.debrief: Quarantining the issue looks right but leaves package installs untrusted. The external leg is the one to break: use the internal mirror, switch off open shell access, and gate or remove public comments. Remove CI secrets too: they add no new leg, but they widen the damage.
